definition: הָוָא verb fall (Arabic id. e.g. of a star Qor 53:1) — Qal Imperative Job 37:6 for he saith to the snow הֱוֵאאָֿ֑רֶץ Fall earthwards (an Arabizing usage). הובנים see [ הָבְנִי ].

הָוָא verb fall (Arabic id. e.g. of a star Qor 53:1) —
